title: Privacy & Data Trust
subtitle: RESOLVE-ONE is local-first. We do not operate tracking trackers, remote customer databases, or telemetry. Your evidence and dispute data remain strictly on your device.
indexedDbDesc: Convex is the single source of truth for your dispute cases, chronological facts, timeline logs, and return records.
localPrefsDesc: Temporary browser state: dark/light theme, active language, and simple language mode toggle.
cloudDesc: Your evidence files and receipts are client-side envelope-encrypted with AES-256-GCM before upload to Convex storage. Zero unencrypted documents ever leave your device.
encryptionDesc: Optionally secure your storage with an AES-GCM 256-bit encryption key derived via PBKDF2 (100,000 rounds).
passphraseWarning: Because RESOLVE-ONE uses zero-knowledge client-side encryption, if you forget your passphrase and lose your recovery key, your encrypted documents cannot be decrypted by anyone.
exportDesc: Download a portable backup of all your cases, timeline logs, and evidence records from Convex.
deleteDesc: Immediately purges all dispute records, evidence files, purchases, and settings from Convex and this browser.
